workerCodeInventory.notes: Worker claim runner has dry-run gate behavior but can run mock no-op/local handlers in existing smokes; this audit does not execute it.
Lease, heartbeat, stale recovery, idempotency, and registry helpers are in-memory/mock or metadata only.
Contracts reject missing approved snapshots, raw prompt-only fields, signed URL source-of-truth values, and secret-like values.
Route metadata includes job, runtime envelope, mock dispatch, and worker lease route IDs; backend-required paths remain blocked by mock router policy.
Existing schema/draft files define future job, lease, heartbeat, and runtime transport shapes. This audit creates no migration and runs no SQL.
